purpose: Feeds usage readings (fresh, high, stale, missing) through the real usage path, checks deferral with the reset time, checks both credit paths are blocked, and checks the upgrade advice fires on the trigger only and stays quiet for a month after a no.
title: Plan recorded, pacing, no spend beyond the plan, upgrade advice once

testCases.description: Set-up asks the plan once and keeps the declared plan in the owner's squire.json
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/usage-and-pacing.test.js::the plan the owner declares at set-up is asked once and kept in the owner's squire.json

testCases.description: The status line command writes the usage snapshot, both windows and their resets, and nothing private
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/usage-and-pacing.test.js::the usage snapshot: the status line command core's settings set writes runtime/usage.json with the model, the context used, both windows and their resets and the time, and nothing else

testCases.description: Above the pacing thresholds a big job is deferred with the reset time; below them it is not
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/usage-and-pacing.test.js::pacing: above 80% of the five-hour window or 70% of the weekly window a big job that can wait is deferred, its warning saying when the allowance resets; below both nothing is deferred

testCases.description: Above 70% of the weekly window Squire says so once a day
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/usage-and-pacing.test.js::pacing: above 70% of the weekly window Squire tells the owner once a day, on their message, and not below it

testCases.description: Stale or missing usage is unknown: every big job asks and nothing is deferred on it
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/usage-and-pacing.test.js::usage that is stale (older than an hour) or missing is unknown: a big job still asks, saying Squire cannot see the plan's usage, and a stale reading defers nothing

testCases.description: A model that may need usage credits is blocked until the owner's yes, by every route the session has
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/no-spend-beyond-plan.test.js::a model outside the plan's set, picked for a subagent, by flag, by settings or by environment, is blocked until the owner's yes, its block naming usage credits; the plan's own models need none

testCases.description: Usage credits and the upgrade page are refused from the session, yes or no
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/no-spend-beyond-plan.test.js::turning on usage credits or opening the upgrade page from the session is refused, and the owner's yes does not lift it
